text:
Priya Rao: hello! just started today and running into a couple cloud permission snags. posting here in case this is common for other new hires.
Priya Rao: 1) On GCP I cant link our project 'redwood-internal-dev' to the billing account "No billing account found". 2) On AWS my console shows Im missing permission to invoke lambdas using the role 'Redwood-Developer'.
Liam O'Connor: welcome Priya! for AWS I can help. what's your iam arn or the account id you see on the top-right?
Priya Rao: my AWS account id is 210987654321. I also get AccessDenied when running `aws lambda invoke` from my workstation.
Liam O'Connor: cool. I see you in the org but the Developer role needs lambda:InvokeFunction and lambda:ListFunctions attached via the 'Redwood-Dev-Base' policy. I'll add that and let you know.
Priya Rao: thanks. for GCP, not sure where the billing id lives. I only have project id redwood-internal-dev.
Farah Khan: billing requests go through Finance's billing account flow. @DevOps Bot can auto-populate the request but we still need an approver. Please file the cloud access ticket and tag your manager. If you're comfortable, I can escalate.
Priya Rao: filing now: https://access.redwood.com/tickets/INC-9876 (selected 'GCP Billing link'). Included project id and reason (dev onboarding).
DevOps Bot: New ticket created: INC-9876. Status: Pending approval from finance. Estimated SLA: 1 business day. Link: https://access.redwood.com/tickets/INC-9876
Liam O'Connor: I attached the Lambda permissions. Try `aws sts get-caller-identity` and then `aws lambda list-functions`.
Priya Rao: ran those commands; list-functions works now. Invoke still gave a 403, trying again.
Liam O'Connor: if you still see 403, check the function resource policy — invoking a function may require permissions on the function resource itself. You can run `aws lambda get-policy --function-name <fn>` to inspect.
Priya Rao: `get-policy` returns "ResourceNotFoundException" for the function, but list shows it. odd.
Farah Khan: that often means the function is in a different account/region. Make sure your AWS region is correct in the CLI profile. Which region are you using?
Priya Rao: oh—my default region was us-east-1 but function is in us-west-2. switching.
Priya Rao: invoke succeeded after switching region 389. thanks Liam and Farah!
DevOps Bot: Reminder: Complete the "cloud onboarding checklist" at https://onboarding.redwood.com/checklist to finish accesses and workspace setup.
Farah Khan: for GCP billing I'll approve the link once finance gives the green light; will post here when done. Meanwhile, for future hires: include billing account id if possible (format BA-XXXX) and manager in the request to avoid back-and-forth.
Priya Rao: will do. appreciate the rapid help 44d
